name: @mindmapper/local
description: MindMapper Local: instala e remove itens aprovados da biblioteca no Claude Code deste computador.

scripts.build:
esbuild src/cli.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node20 --format=esm --outfile=dist/mm.mjs --banner:js="#!/usr/bin/env node
import { createRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);"
